checks.diagnostic: The sole ordinary-library diagnostic is dead_code for enable_mp_rom_compat; parent-owned strict ROM loader call is intentionally absent from this module-only change.

negativeChecks.reason: Test incorrectly assumed vendor EF. Existing explicitly virtual shared flash JEDEC returns20. Assertion corrected; capacity byte19 and physical firmware unchanged.

negativeChecks.diagnostic: Two test hex literals used unequal byte grouping; corrected to 0x0019_4020.

supportedCommandScope.SPI0: CMD0 only; all nonzero software commands reject
supportedCommandScope.SPI1Dedicated: One trigger per write; RDSR/RDID/WREN/WRDI/WRSR/PP/SE/CE and existing power state paths; READ newly bounded to 1..64 real bytes; FLASH_PE permitted only with USR
supportedCommandScope.SPI1User: One 8-bit SPI command phase; STR, byte-multiple W0..W15 lengths <=64; existing explicit known flash opcodes and separately validated Quad PSRAM; no host simultaneous TX/RX/highpart/CRC/octal/DDR/held-CS extension

limits: Opaque words are behavioral virtual compatibility, not a claimed silicon register/reset definition.
Computed-port SPI0 arbitrary lengths and command engines remain unsupported.
No new four-byte flash mode; MMU/JEDEC capacity tests do not establish a die command protocol.
Existing virtual JEDEC is not a physical board manufacturer/device ID.
No analog/cache-line latency or timing calibration, ECC/PMS/XTS/NAND/HPM or dedicated C5 32KiB erase engine.
No bus/soc/shared edits or broad builds/benchmarks; native strict negative proof only.
Integration must wire opt-in after ROM validation and rerun ordinary Clippy, factory/native/Worker acceptance and regression checks.
privacy: Public source URLs/hashes and aggregate checks only; personal paths and raw tool captures omitted from committed evidence.
